hooks.name: crowndoc-xref-validate
hooks.description: Validate crowndoc cross-references when markdown files are modified
hooks.prompt: A crowndoc markdown file was modified. Check if any cross-references in the format [DOCUMENT.md], [ver:X.X.X, sect:Y)] need updating. If the file contains cross-references, verify they point to valid documents and sections. Report any broken references.

hooks.name: crowndoc-todo-complete
hooks.description: Prompt to update CHANGELOG when TODO task is marked complete
hooks.prompt: TODO.md was modified. If a task was marked complete (changed from [ ] to [x]), remind to update CHANGELOG.md with a corresponding entry and cross-reference. Use format: [CHANGELOG.md], [ver:X.X.X, sect:Y)]

hooks.name: crowndoc-version-archive
hooks.prompt: A LIVE crowndoc document was modified. If all tasks in the current version are complete, remind to: 1) Archive to docs/{TODO,SD}/complete/X.X.X.md 2) Increment version in root document 3) Update cross-references
